name: Shifter Guileful Shifter
body:
A guileful shifter uses guile talents to complement his shapeshifting abilities and become a truly versatile and mercurial spy.

Trade Tradition

If this is the character’s first level in any class, the guileful shifter may select a trade tradition of his choice, and have an adroit trade rank (regardless of his skill ranks per level).

This replaces the shifter’s normal class skills.

Skill Expertise (Ex)

The guileful shifter is a Journeyman operative, gaining skill spheres and talents as described in Using Spheres of Guile.

This replaces enhanced attacks and enhanced physicality.

Consummate Actor

The guileful shifter can select troubadour actor trainings in place of bestial traits, using his shifter level as his troubadour level to qualify for the selected trainings and using them. He needs to meet all other prerequisites for these actor trainings.

The Bardess’ Library #9: Guile, © 2025, Legendary Games; Author: Margherita Tramontano.
